declarations.name: todoPens
declarations.description:
The default pens, in order: pen `1` is blue, `2` red and so on. A task stores its pen by position (`ink: 2`); these
names are only read from older data (`ink: 'red'`) and mapped to their position. Each background maps them to
readable inks.

declarations.name: todoHighlights
declarations.description: The default highlighters, in order, mixed into the list's own background so they suit every theme. Stored by position like the pens.

declarations.name: todoColorIndex
declarations.description:
The 1-based position of a colour from what a task holds: a number, or a default colour's name (`red` → 2), which is
how tasks saved before positions were stored keep their colour.

declarations.name: todoBackgrounds
todoPalettes
declarations.description: The default palettes, in order (palette 1 is classic): each sets the accent, the pens and the highlighters, in a light and a dark variant.

The backgrounds used while `backgrounds` is unset (position 0, the default background, is not in the list). Each sets
its surfaces and its text colour; the pens and highlighters on it come from a palette. The values are set inline on

declarations.description:
The palettes used while `palettes` is unset. Every one is checked by script: each pen, and each background's text
colour, reads at 4.5:1 or better on every default background, plain and under each of the palette's highlighters,
in the matching light or dark variant. Each accent reads at 4.5:1 or better on every light background (its dark
variant on night), and so does the Add button's text on it: white on the light accent, near-black on the dark one.

declarations.description:
A to-do list with the feel of a paper one: tasks are plain text, checked off with a hand-drawn tick (or cross) and
a pen stroke through the text. Progress shows as a ring beside the heading, a bar, or a large hero ring. Click a
task to read its whole note, drag a row to reorder it, and swipe it left to archive or delete it or right to check it (the
swipe and the reordering come from `c2-reorder-list`). The row's ⋯ menu (also a right-click, and the keys F2, I, X,
E and Delete) holds the same actions plus the task's icon, highlighter and text colour, each changed in place.
Edit task (or F2) turns its name and note into fields; they are saved on Enter or as soon as the focus leaves them,
and Escape cancels. Clicking a task only shows its whole note.
Archived tasks collect in a section at the bottom, and every removal can be undone.

With `customizable`, a palette button swaps the tasks for a panel that styles the whole list: the list's icon, the
background (whose text colour and pens follow from it), the palette (its accent, pens and highlighters), the done
mark, the density and the progress style. `look.pen` still sets the accent from script. With
`storage-key` those choices are remembered in `localStorage`.

With `heading-editable`, the heading is a `c2-inline-edit`: click it (or call `editHeading()`) to rename the list,
Enter or leaving the field saves, Escape cancels, and `heading-change` reports the new heading. The icon suggested
from the heading follows the new name.

The swipe actions are drawn by the inner `c2-reorder-list`: recolour them with its
`--c2-reorder-list__swipe-action__{warning,danger,success}--background-color` variables, set on this element.

members.name: heading
members.description: Title of the list.

members.name: headingEditable
members.description:
The heading can be renamed in place: it becomes a `c2-inline-edit`, shown even while empty (with
`heading-placeholder`). Ignored while `readonly`.

members.name: headingPlaceholder
members.description: What an editable heading shows while it is empty.

members.name: actionsPlacement
members.description: Where the `actions` slot sits: before the customize button (`start`) or after it (`end`).

members.name: headingLevel
members.description: Heading level (1-6) the title is announced with.

members.name: icon
members.description:
Icon beside the heading: a list icon (`work`, `groceries`, `travel`… see `todoListIcons`), or any `@c2n/task-icons`
name. Suggested from the heading when missing; `none` leaves it empty.

members.name: tasks
members.description: The tasks. Accepts a JSON array in the attribute. The list updates it as the user works.

members.name: pens
members.description:
The pens a task's text can take: each entry a CSS colour (`var()` included), or `{ value, name }` to give its
swatch a friendly name (`{ "value": "#4f46e5", "name": "Brand" }`); without one it is called `Pen 2`. A task stores
its pen by 1-based position (`ink: 2`), so give a dark theme a list of the same length and order and every task
recolours. Unset, the five documented `--c2-todo-list__pen-*` pens, which the palettes recolour. A list you give is
used as given: its contrast is yours to choose.

members.name: highlights
members.description: The highlighters behind a task, as colours or `{ value, name }` entries mixed into the background, stored by position like `pens`. Unset, the six documented `--c2-todo-list__highlight-*` highlighters.

members.name: backgrounds
members.description:
The backgrounds the customize panel offers, after its default one (position 0, which follows the theme), as
`{ value, color, name }` entries: `value` the surface, `color` the text. The look stores the viewer's choice by
position, so a dark theme can hand over a list of the same length and order. Unset, the six default backgrounds,
which were checked for contrast; a list you give is used as given, and its contrast is yours to choose.

members.name: palettes
members.description:
The palettes the customize panel offers, as `{ name, accent, pens, highlights, strength, dark }` entries: the
accent, and pen and highlighter values by position, with optional `dark` overrides used on a dark background.
Stored by position like `backgrounds`. Unset, the four default palettes, which were checked for contrast against
the default backgrounds; a list you give is used as given.

members.name: progress
members.description: How progress is drawn: a ring beside the heading, a bar under it, a large ring above it, or not at all. The viewer's choice in the customize panel wins.

members.name: customizable
members.description: Shows the palette button and its customize panel, where the viewer styles the whole list.

members.name: storageKey
members.description:
Remembers the viewer's customization in `localStorage` under `c2-todo-list:<storage-key>`. Give every list on a
site its own key.

members.name: persistTasks
members.description: With `storage-key`, also remembers the tasks, which then win over the `tasks` the page provides.

members.name: readonly
members.description: Tasks cannot be checked, added, reordered, swiped, removed or edited. The look can still be customized.

members.name: placeholder
members.default: 'Add a task — a note after a dash'
members.description: Placeholder of the add field.

members.name: look
members.description: The viewer's customization. Set it to apply a look from script; the panel and `storage-key` keep it up to date.

members.name: expandedId
members.description: The task whose whole note is shown, where the row shows only its first line.

members.name: editingId
members.description: The task being edited: its name and note become fields.

members.name: panelIconOpen
members.description: Whether the customize panel shows the picker for the list's icon.

members.name: panelPaletteOpen
members.description: Whether the customize panel lists every palette, rather than only the current one.

members.name: darkSurface
members.description: Whether the default background turned out dark (a dark theme), which picks a palette's dark variant.

members.name: hydrating
members.description: Hydrating server-rendered markup, which was drawn without what `localStorage` holds.

members.name: resetLook
members.description: Forget the viewer's customization and return to the authored look.

members.name: handleDocumentEscape
members.description: Escape closes an open menu or icon picker wherever focus is, e.g. after a menu opened on hover.

members.name: toggleNote
members.description: A click on the task's text never edits it (that is Edit task, in the menu): it shows or hides the whole note.

members.name: handleEditorFocusOut
members.description: Focus left the editor (a click outside the list, on another row or a menu, Tab away): save and read again.

members.name: finishEdit
members.description: Saves the name and note in one change and returns to read mode. An empty name keeps the old one.

members.name: renderHeading
members.description: The heading: plain text, or with `heading-editable` an inline edit that renames the list.

members.name: handleHeadingChange
members.description: The inline edit committed a new heading. Its own `change` stays inside: the list reports `heading-change`.

members.name: editHeading
members.description:
Opens the heading's editor with its text selected, as a click on it does (a list that was just created, a Rename
command). Returns `false` when the heading cannot be edited: `heading-editable` is off or the list is `readonly`.

members.name: renderFilteredTasks
members.description:
The filter is a `c2-tabs` strip over the list. Each filter has its own panel and only the selected one holds the
tasks: `c2-tabs` shows a panel as soon as its tab is clicked, before this element renders again. The slots are
written here as well so server-rendered markup shows the strip and the list before `c2-tabs` hydrates.

members.name: renderIconChooser
members.description: The searchable, grouped icon grid shared by a task's icon popover and the customize panel.

members.name: backgroundOf
members.description: The background at a look's position, or `undefined` for the default background and a position the list does not have.

members.name: activePalette
members.description: The chosen palette; a chosen background without one brings the first palette, whose colours were checked against it.

members.name: colorOf
members.description: A task's pen or highlighter position, or `undefined` when it has none or the current list is shorter.

members.name: colorVars
members.description:
`--_pen-<n>` and `--_highlight-<n>` for every colour of the lists, set on the container next to the palette's
variables, so a new list (or a palette) recolours every task in place. A position the list does not have stays
unset.

members.name: renderPalettePreview
members.description: A tiny list in the palette: a progress ring and a tick in its accent, and three rows under its highlighters.

members.name: renderPaletteField
members.description: A dropdown: the current palette on the trigger, every palette in the list it opens.

members.name: renderListIconField
members.description: A dropdown: the current icon on the trigger, the named list icons in the popup it opens.
